title: Restart the encoded forward and inverse balanced CRT endpoints on one 79-role inventory with paid reentry and retained history
body:
## Result
The encoded forward and inverse CRT endpoints now reuse one 79-role inventory across any finite successful sequence, including changing geometry. This closes the same-inventory restart question in #7352; #7351/#7352 already supply the numerical maps.

All invocation costs remain charged. Time is initial cost plus sum O(A_i^4); retained private backing is at most K0 + 3 Amax dmax + 74 Amax + 23 dmax + 223. Rearm and finish add exactly 396 raw actions per call. Ten predecessor runtime files remain unchanged.

## Verification
Base: e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57.
Run `python3 -I -W error -B research/encoded-crt-restart/verify.py`: 174 calls, 270 nodes, 14 controls; optimized replay agrees. A separate modular-inverse oracle checks 32 calls and 96 nodes, and independent source/proof review verifies the successful-retirement induction and per-role historical maxima.

## Limits and kappa
No new kappa; 0.00363005817 remains conditional on all five assumptions. Clean initial tails and successful linear use are explicit premises. Source preparation, payload routing, binary lowering and the outer caller remain open; no failed-call recovery is claimed.

## Credit
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance. Credit #5505, #7152, #7154, #7351, #7352 and their authors. Separate AI review is not human or formal-kernel acceptance.

Full proof, exact pins, checks and open questions: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/30ae49d57441e9f1ffa7233f8f64729988a2fca1/research/encoded-crt-restart

title: Normalize the selected complex layer and perform its single toward-zero return with a literal 18-tape program
body:
## Result
A fixed 18-tape, 17,814-location program reads the actual nine-Gamma header and returns Q_p(b^D z), b=(1-i)/2, with one final toward-zero projection. It stages signed output, checks exact range, commits to the original DATA owner, erases the old tail and restores all successful heads/private tapes.

This supplies the literal numerical egress left after #3127's encoded normalization. Complete time and historical backing bounds are O(V) in the selected bands. Global d and actual D remain distinct; the supplied format conversion uses the coupled selected widths.

## Verification
Base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Run `python3 -I -W error -B research/literal-layer-egress/verify.py`: 771 packets, 12 tensor fixtures, six mutants; optimized replay agrees. A separate dense CPU checks 20 packets and three mutants. Independent proof/source review checks 174,752 signed rows, 4,106 ranges and four controls.

## Limits and credit
No new kappa; 0.00363005817 and all five assumptions remain. Recursive C, the S sweeps, complete caller packet, paid format conversion and disjoint owned backing are supplied. Numerical rejection preserves DATA but promises no cleanup/restart. This is not a complete layer.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance. Credit #3127, #2287, #3087, #3091, #3098, #7000, #7349, #7350 and retained source authors. Separate AI review is not human or formal-kernel acceptance.

title: Locate every expanded compiler leaf and preserve its source or owned-bank identity through recursive return
body:
## Result
Locate and invert every ordinal in the separated compiler's recursively expanded rank-one paid-leaf projection. A weighted suffix table preserves each chronological cut while upward port translation identifies the original source row or namespaced owned bank. Input ports of one whole invocation are injective; different leaves may revisit one physical field.

This composes #7345's library with the #7346, #7347 and #7348 occurrence/source/complement codecs. All actual integer lengths, setup, path copying and a separate serialized-tape simulation are charged; no free payload access is inferred.

## Verification
Base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Run `python3 -I -W error -B research/chronological-leaf-owner-index/verify.py`: 4,102 leaves, 2,970 calls, 15 controls; optimized replay agrees. A separate nonminimal-library recursion oracle checks 24,137 leaves, 24,205 calls, 25,120 ports and three mutants. Eight exact source pins and the universal proof received separate review.

## Limits and credit
No new kappa; selected 0.00363005817 remains conditional on all five assumptions. The full scalar/phase/adapter word, physical gather/return, numerical endpoints and actual selected huge library remain open. Larger ambient A accepts a supplied valid library; default-ambient width bounds are not transferred.
